package.description: Somali-first programming language with native Somali syntax and dual typing.

en-US.description: Somali-first programming language with native Somali syntax and dual typing.
en-US.longDescription:
Soplang is a modern programming language designed with Somali syntax at its core.
It offers dual typing modes (static & dynamic), improved readability, and educational value
for Somali-speaking developers.
en-US.name: Soplang
